legacy_overflow_reconciliation.history: The initial run reported 84/86: the two 320px legacy (Plan OFF) cells A-plan-20__active_plan__320__{en,tr}__plan-off_coach-off_weekly-off overflowed the document horizontally by 24px (EN) / 36px (TR). Per answer.txt (2026-07-26), 'pre-existing legacy' was NOT accepted as an implicit quality-gate exception; the defect was reconciled.
legacy_overflow_reconciliation.proof_pre_existing: Reproduced identically on a clean detached checkout of base 9400641 AND on HEAD with every PR3 flag OFF (24px EN / 36px TR both); the base and HEAD-flags-OFF screenshots are byte-identical (48272 B EN, 48437 B TR). The legacy /training render files (training.html, _head/_nav/_actionbar, theme.css, training.css, training.js) are git-diff-identical to base; PR3's only shared-file changes on that path (nav.css new .coach-page-* classes, actions.js window.fxReload, coach_widget.js lifecycle guard) do not alter the legacy layout. Evidence: legacy-overflow/{diag-overflow-base.json, diag-overflow-head.json, investigation.md, *-{base,head}.png}.
legacy_overflow_reconciliation.root_cause: static/training.css '.wstats { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) }': the three .stat-card grid items (default min-width:auto) cannot shrink below their locale-dependent text min-content at 320px, so the tracks total 328px (EN) / 340px (TR) inside a 288px content box. The locale-dependent magnitude (TR 36 > EN 24, driven by a wider first Turkish label track 122.9px vs 106.7px) confirms a text-min-content cause, not a fixed width / ring / transform. #cw-send (position:fixed) reports a rect past the edge but is not the scrollWidth driver (Plan V2 loads the same widget and is overflow-clean).
legacy_overflow_reconciliation.fix: static/training.css: @media (max-width: 380px) { .wstats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }. Presentation-only; legacy-only (training.css is loaded solely by templates/training.html and .wstats appears in no other template); inert under Plan ON (plan.html has no .wstats) and on Nav (PR1) / Today (PR2); the 390px+ layout is byte-identical. No business-rule / training-authority / workout-selection / localStorage change. Regression test: tests/test_training_ui.py::test_wstats_collapses_to_fewer_columns_on_narrow_screens (verified genuine: absent in base 9400641, present on HEAD).
legacy_overflow_reconciliation.after: Both 320px legacy cells now measure doc_horizontal_overflow=false (scrollWidth=clientWidth=320, EN and TR) — legacy-overflow/diag-overflow-headfix.json + *-headfix.png. Full Plan matrix re-run: 86/86.
